data.narrative:
Atomic AI is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Raphael Townshend, having raised $42M to date. The valuation framework draws on a comp universe spanning 3 public biotech firms (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method. Using total capital raised ($42M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied post-money valuation of $84M. Peer-median comparison is not applicable due to insufficient narrow-stage comparables: while 7 same-sector peers exist, only 1 was identified at an adjacent stage and none cluster in similar valuation tiers, falling below the minimum 3-datapoint threshold. Public-comp anchoring cannot be performed because Atomic AI's revenue is not disclosed; the median public sector P/S multiple is 8.1x across the 3 tickers, but this metric is not actionable without revenue data.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $71M to $97M, centered at $84M. This range rests on a single methodological pillar, however, which constrains confidence. Key uncertainties include the absence of revenue visibility, limited transaction comparables at this stage in the sector, and the validity of the 2.0x step-up assumption for this specific company. Additional diligence on operational metrics and market positioning would be required to narrow the range.
